channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 05
item.description:
3 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Mothers now defend calves when they are hurt, and breeding commands for bulls and cows have been improved.
  • Fixed a client crash that occurred when a calf died due to missing ragdoll setup.

NPC & AI

  • Mothers now defend calves when they are hurt, and breeding commands for bulls and cows have been improved.
  • Fixed a client crash that occurred when a calf died due to missing ragdoll setup.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 04
item.description:
58 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Cows now remember being attacked and can kick when you get too close while fleeing; calves run faster to keep up with their mothers.
  • Livestock AI improvements: grazing fullness decay fixed, drink rate restored, starving animals can roam for food, path resets prevented on unplaced agents, and cows idle/rest behavior corrected.
  • Fixed livestock fixtures breaking with the new navmesh and corrected AI state handling for livestock.
  • Fixed AI kicking action not working.
  • Crocodiles now correctly enter the onNavmesh state, fixing their movement and spawning behavior.

Achievements

  • Added a new achievement for inserting a heavy fuse into the power plant and improved tracking of which player moves items for accurate achievement and analytics.

Scrap King Building DLC

  • Introduced building grade, localization, and an upgrade command for the Scrap King building skin, expanding DLC building functionality.

Weapons & Items

  • Paintball gun now correctly updates its colour when equipped.
  • Fixed arrow reloading bug where switching to a different arrow type caused arrows to load before the arrowhead.

Store UI

  • Store UI stability fixes: added a loading blocker when the store isn’t fully warmed up and repaired a crash when pressing store items.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Guide mesh fixes improve building placement accuracy for many structures (boat station, wind turbine, tripod spotlight, small engine, tier‑3 workbench, cannon, sail, chandelier, planters).
  • Character creator FOV issue resolved, giving a wider view when customizing your character.
  • Bee grenade visual drift and clipping fixed, ensuring the grenade and its bees render correctly.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 03
item.description:
55 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Livestock behavior overhaul: cows age, slow down, sleep, regroup at night, hunger/thirst and grazing bugs fixed, plus new sheep/lamb corpse handling and death animations.
  • Gen2 AI position update bug fixed, improving AI movement and spatial queries.

Building & Deployables

  • New sandbag barricade variants: half-height and three-quarter-height with proper collision and nav obstacles.

Combat & Weapons

  • Grenade client prediction improvements: server alignment lerp and immediate release mode bugs fixed for more reliable throws.
  • Flare throw offset reverted, adjusting throw trajectory to previous behavior.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Compactor and stove menus no longer show incorrect "Turn on"/"Turn off" options.
  • Character creator ghost figure bug fixed, preventing invisible man from appearing.
  • Animal fences now emit distinct sounds, helping players hear fence interactions.

Bug Fixes

  • Prevent crashes caused by missing particle systems in power‑grid visual effects.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Livestock now spawn with coats that can be harvested for resources and affect their appearance.
